chunks: It is He who made the night and day an alternation for him who cares to reflect and be grateful.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the alternation between night and day in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the teleological purpose of cosmic cycles, where the alternation of night and day serves as a divine sign (ayah) for both intellectual contemplation and spiritual gratitude. Scholars emphasize that this duality is not random but a deliberate mechanism for human self-purification, inviting believers to utilize the tranquility of night for reflection and the energy of day for active worship.
